expires_today.title: Kodansha Presents: BL, Yuri & More from Ichijinsha
expires_today.description: Get over $1200 worth of BL, Yuri & Other Hit Ichijinsha Manga in one bundle
expires_today.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Looking to bolster your digital manga collection with BL, Yuri and more while also saving big in the process? Get more than 100 digital volumes and over $1200 worth of fan-favorite series like How to Deal When Your Intimidating Neighbor is Actually an Omega, I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day (Anime debuting this summer), and Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku for only $30 with the Kodansha Presents: BL, Yuri & More from Ichijinsha bundle. A Humble-first, this bundle is the best way to experience Kodansha's Ichijinsha manga offerings while also supporting the Comic Book Legal Defense Fund—a non-profit organization dedicated to protecting the First Amendment rights of the comics art form and its community of retailers, creators, publishers, librarians, and readers.

expires_today.title: Critical Hits: ARPG Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Gather your weapons, rev your engines, and prepare for your greatest adventure yet with this bundle of action-adventure RPGs! Complete a hero-less land’s backlog of quests and survive the tricky combat mechanics of RPG parody game The Last Hero of Nostalgaia! Keep your bow strung and your enemies in your sights in the dark Baba Yaga origin myth retelling Blacktail! Explore uncharted new lands in the cult-classic Greedfall! There are so many more worlds to explore and quests to discover in this action-adventure bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support the global efforts of Whale and Dolphin Conservation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before June 12th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Ultimate ABLAZE Manga Collection
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Manga library looking a little empty? We can fix that! We’ve teamed up with ABLAZE to bring you a huge bundle of the publisher’s most beloved manga, manhwa, and pinoy manga ebook series and collections, perfect for oldheads and new fans alike! Dive into the cutthroat world of professional chess (and pick up a few moves as you read) in Blitz! Discover the mystery of a hidden painting in JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure one-shot Rohan at the Louvre! Jump back in time to one of the O.G.s of science fiction manga (and one of director James Cameron’s favorite characters) in the Captain Harlock collection! That’s only a taste of what we have in store for you in this mega manga bonanza, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support Starlight Children’s Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: 12 for $10
expires_tomorrow.description: Great games at a great discount
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
What’s better than getting a bunch of fun, exciting video games you can play for hours? Getting them at a fantastic discount! Our latest 12 for $10 bundle is exactly what it says on the tin: 12 of our favorite games for just $10. Put your hand-eye coordination and fine motor skills to the test with the famously tricky (and famously fun) platformer Super Meat Boy! Enter the pixelated world of an ’80s cop show and solve the murders at the heart of Beat Cop! Hunt down anomalies and battle swarms of enemies in the cyberpunk action-adventure Anomaly Agent! There’s a lot more fun to be had in this bundle, so grab it now for just $10, and support buildOn with your purchase!

Keys expire. All titles should be redeemed before June 19th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Lost Lands Adventure for 5th Edition by Frog God Games
expires_tomorrow.description: Can you survive the Lost Lands?
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Can you survive the Lost Lands? Gather your friends and roll the dice, because it’s time to journey into the Lost Lands! We’ve teamed up with Frog God Games for this massive TTRPG bundle chock-full of resources to plan your next campaign. Explore the winding streets of Bard’s Gate, a citadel of artisans and politicians whose people are menaced by dark forces within and without. Use the Tome of Artifacts to scatter magical weapons and relics throughout the land for your players to find. Find a starting point for your adventure with expanded description manuals like Rappan Athuk: Adventures in Zelkor’s Ferry. You can even score a physical copy of The World of the Lost Lands, the definitive guide to the entire setting, full of information on its locations, peoples, and historical data! Endless adventure awaits you in this bundle of nearly 80 TTRPG ebooks, so grab it now at the price of your choice and support Doctors Without Borders with your purchase!
